title: A masked edit shows the model only the mask box, so it cannot keep what is outside it
description: Proven from the dispatched graph, 2026-09-22 (Fabio's MPI-877 round-2 run, ComfyUI /history). On a masked edit the model never sees the rest of the picture. `Input_Mask` (node 296, output 4) drives an `MpiIfElse` (592) that forwards `InpaintCropImproved`'s CROP instead of `Input_Image`; the crop goes to `ImageScaleToTotalPixels` -> `VAEEncode` -> the sampler, and `context_from_mask_extend_factor: 1.0` makes that crop the mask bounding box and nothing more (`output_resize_to_target_size` then blows it up to 1024x1024). Measured on the live run: mask bbox 257x257 at (264,683) in a 768x1024 card - pure water. The ask was 'turn the boy's REFLECTION into a demon version of HIMSELF'; Klein saw a square of ripples with no boy in it and invented an unrelated creature. Fabio: 'a demon face that has got nothing to do with the boy'. The prompt cannot fix this and neither can the agent - a reference the model is never shown is not a reference. Not agent-specific either: the Cue path in the History workspace injects the same `Input_Mask` into the same graph, so a hand-painted masked edit has always worked this way. Two candidate directions, Fabio's call: raise `context_from_mask_extend_factor` above 1.0 so the crop carries surroundings (cheap, affects every masked op on every master graph), or feed the WHOLE picture into a free reference slot on the models that have one (kleinEdit takes three images, and injection is ordinal - MPI-877 deliberately left those slots alone). Whichever wins needs a real render to judge, not a spec. Split out of MPI-877, which fixed only where the edit LANDS and which picture the mask binds to.
